english.title: Buggery with a woman
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) committed buggery with a woman
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(1) of the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and location
committed buggery with a woman

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence became OBSOLETE from 03/11/1994

If the woman does not consent to the act, the offence becomes a serious arrestable offence.No longer an offence/no modern equivalent. MoPI Group 2 has been allocated for manual review to ensure that any additional risk factors are captured as appropriateThis offence is obselete with no exact modern equivalent. Historical records must be reviewed case-by-case and graded/retained according to the modern equivalent, taking into account individual case circumstances, victim capacity and consent, and ages of victim and offender.

other.penalty:
Indictable: Life imprisonment or a fine.
